label: Now Developing
items: House prosecutors dropped three impeachment articles against Vice President Sara Duterte, leaving only unexplained wealth; she said she will never resign and will run in 2028.
The House passed the ₱7.2-trillion 2027 budget on third reading, 281-13, and a Sandiganbayan witness said ₱1 billion in cash went to Martin Romualdez.
Marcos called the Ayungin water-cannon medevac a new phase of West Philippine Sea escalation, while a Riyadh airport attack stranded OFWs and left four Filipinos hurt.
